summary: Black Friday half-day (NYSE closes 1 PM ET): risk-on rebound after Wednesday's AI/chip selloff, SPY +1.4% to 726.5 and QQQ +2.0% to 646.9 pre-market (IBKR realtime), each near a full implied-move gap, but chip leaders faded from their pre-market highs into the open. No US data today; a December Fed hike is near fully priced after 3.8% PCE. Option quotes were still wide before the 9:30 open, so no pick is rated 55 yet; updates will re-rate once spreads tighten.

picks.name: Amazon
picks.reason: Black Friday kicks off the holiday shopping season (Adobe expects online sales +9.2%). Pre-market calls outnumber puts 2.9 to 1, and the +2.4% gap is inside the implied move with a tight 249.4-252.75 range. Held at 54 because IV is in the 87th percentile (13-week) and option spreads were wide before the open; a break over the 252.75 pre-market high opens 255.56.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Rebound after Wednesday's AI selloff; the Huang reinstatement is older news. The +1.8% gap is only 0.4x the implied move and pre-market calls outnumber puts 2 to 1 on heavy pre-market volume (14M), but the stock faded from 157 to 152 and IV is in the 99th percentile. A reclaim of 154.40 is needed; losing 149.30 fills the gap.

picks.name: Broadcom
picks.reason: Laggard after the reported Google TPU order cut: up only +1.4% against QQQ's +2.0%, and it dropped from 310.75 to 302.25 on 84k shares in the last pre-market 15 minutes. The risk-on tape, a 9 to 1 call-heavy pre-market and earnings on Dec 9 keep this under 50. Losing 302.25 targets the 300.86 gap fill and 297.80.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Chip rebound: the +3.6% gap is only 0.6x the implied move and pre-market calls lead puts 1.6 to 1. However, the stock slid from the 435.54 pre-market high to near its 419.5 low, and IV is at its 13-week high, so this needs a push over 428.87 (Nov 24 high) to work.

picks.name: Micron Technology
picks.reason: Gap-fade setup: the +5.7% gap is about 1.0x the implied move, the biggest stretch among the chips, and it has already faded from 650.40 to 636. Pre-market volume is heavy (2.7M, about 9% of a normal day). Pre-market calls outnumber puts 3 to 1 and the tape is risk-on, so this needs a break under 629.79 (Nov 24 close).

picks.name: Walmart
picks.reason: Rotation out of defensives: flat while QQQ is up 2%, sitting under its 133.19 13-week high. Options are cheap (IV around the 55th percentile), but there is no catalyst and pre-market volume is thin (0.13M), so confidence is low. A break of the 131.00 pre-market low targets 129.9.
